title: Destructor Music Disc
description: A texture pack that changes the creator music disc into a remade version called Destructor
body:
This texture pack changes the creator music disc into a remade version called Destructor, changes the texture and the text and audio files :D

i made this with a friend (he did art) cus i was bored and he wanted it :D

i should mention, im not going to update it but it will work in any version beyond 1.21

this song was made by https://www.youtube.com/@NoughtZeroMusic you should subscribe its a peak song (my friend just sent me the link to the song and we turned it into a texture pack lol)
